task_completion.description: Open Firefox and activate the Accessibility Inspector tool.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Firefox browser is open with the 'Accessibility' tab visible in the Developer Tools pane.

task_completion.description: Navigate to Wikipedia and identify at least two accessibility issues using the inspector.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent inspecting elements on en.wikipedia.org with the Accessibility Inspector highlighting specific nodes or contrast issues.

task_completion.description: Navigate to Craigslist and identify at least two accessibility issues using the inspector.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent inspecting elements on craigslist.org with the Accessibility Inspector active.

task_completion.description: Navigate to Internet Archive and identify at least two accessibility issues using the inspector.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent inspecting elements on archive.org with the Accessibility Inspector active.

task_completion.description: Save the findings to ~/Documents/accessibility_audit.json with the correct structure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal shows the file /home/ga/Documents/accessibility_audit.json containing the 'audit_metadata' and 'sites' keys with at least 6 total issues (2 per site) and WCAG criteria.

integrity.description: Verify the agent actually used the Firefox Accessibility Inspector rather than just browsing the sites.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Accessibility panel in Firefox DevTools must be visible and populated with the accessibility tree or contrast warnings during the audit of each site.

integrity.description: Ensure the agent didn't simply write the file without visiting the websites.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser history or active tabs must show navigation to all three required domains before the JSON file is created.

integrity.description: Check that WCAG criteria follow the standard numbering format.
integrity.visual_evidence: The JSON file content shows 'wcag_criterion' values matching the pattern X.X.X (e.g., 1.4.3) and not placeholder text.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must audit three specific domains: en.wikipedia.org, craigslist.org, and archive.org. It must find at least 2 issues per site (6 total). The output must be a JSON file at /home/ga/Documents/accessibility_audit.json. Valid WCAG criteria follow the regex ^[1-4]\.\d+(\.\d+)?$. The tool used must be the Firefox Accessibility Inspector.
